class.name: HTTPRequest
class.brief_description: One inbound HTTP request received by a server.
class.description: A read-only view of a single inbound HTTP request: the method, the request target with its query string, the header fields, the body, and the address of the remote peer. Instances are created by the server; scripts never construct one themselves. This class lives in the [code]foundry.http.server[/code] namespace, so it is reached either by its fully qualified name [code skip-lint]foundry.http.server.HTTPRequest[/code] or, after [code]import foundry.http.server[/code], by the bare name [code]HTTPRequest[/code]. Without that import the bare name does not resolve. [b]Note:[/b] The server does not open a listening socket yet, so no request is delivered to a handler at runtime.

method.name: get_body
method.description: Returns the request body exactly as it arrived on the wire.

method.name: get_body_string
method.description: Returns the request body decoded as UTF-8. Returns an empty string when there is no body.

method.name: get_header
method.description: Returns the value of the [param name] header field, or an empty string when the request does not carry it. The lookup is case-insensitive. A field the client repeated is returned as a single comma-separated value.

method.name: get_headers
method.description: Returns a copy of all header fields, keyed by the name exactly as the client spelled it. Mutating the returned dictionary does not change the request.

method.name: get_method
method.description: Returns the request method in upper case, for example [code]GET[/code] or [code]POST[/code].

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the percent-decoded path of the request target, without the query string. A [code]+[/code] in the path is a literal character, unlike in the query string.

method.name: get_peer
method.description: Returns the address of the remote peer that sent the request, or an empty string when it is unknown.

method.name: get_query
method.description: Returns a copy of the parsed query string as string keys mapped to string values. Keys and values are form-decoded, so [code]+[/code] stands for a space. A key that appears without a value maps to an empty string, and a key that appears more than once keeps the value that came last; read [method get_raw_path] to recover every occurrence. Mutating the returned dictionary does not change the request.

method.name: get_raw_path
method.description: Returns the request target exactly as it arrived, still percent-encoded and including the query string.

method.name: has_header
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the request carries the [param name] header field. The lookup is case-insensitive.
